The source URL points to the same domain referenced in the `url` field, indicating consistency between documentation and source location. No obfuscation, unexpected dependencies, or suspicious scripts are present.

This file poses no direct security risk. While using a tagged VCS source instead of a pinned commit allows for potential tag rewrites (a minor supply-chain hygiene concern), this alone does not constitute malicious behavior, especially without evidence of `git pull` during build time or execution of unchecked remote content. The package follows standard AUR packaging practices.
